sentences.text: This is an application for pre-arrest bail.

applicant is apprehending arrest in connection with C.R.
 No.81 of 2022 dated 13/03/2022 registered with Central  Police Station, Ulhasnagar for the offence punishable under  
 Urmila Ingale 915. aba 1040.22.doc sections 377, 498A, 406, 323, 34 of the Indian Penal Code,
1860.
3.
The complainant married the applicant on 22/05/2017.
In the complaint, it is alleged that the applicant was ill-treating her and on some occasion, had taken money from her as she was working and drawing handsome salary.
In the complaint, certain details of the nature of harassment are mentioned.
General allegations are made pertaining to the harassment meted out to the applicant.
The applicant has filed an affidavit stating that he is willing to deposit a sum of Rs. 5 lakhs without prejudice to his rights and contentions.

Learned counsel for the applicant on instructions submits that he has no objection if this amount of Rs. 5 lakhs is paid over to the complainant without prejudice to rights and contentions of the applicant.
In the event if it is found that the complainant is not entitled to the said amount, the complainant will have to return the said amount.

Considering the nature of the allegations which are an Rohit Bharat Ahuja vs State Of Maharashtra on 17 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/107339902/

sentences.text: Hence, the following order.

ORDER (a) In the event of arrest of the applicant in connection with C.R. No. 81 of 2022 dated 13/03/2022 registered with Central Police Station, Ulhasnagar, the applicant- Rohit Bharat Ahuja be released on bail on his furnishing P.R. Bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- with one or more sureties in the like amount;

(b) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with facts of case so as to dissuade him from disclosing the facts to Court or any Police Officer and should not tamper with evidence;
(c) The applicant shall attend the invesigating officer on 20th and 21st January 2023 between 11.00 a.m. and 1.00 p.m. and thereafter as and when called for.
(d) The applicant shall pay to the complainant a sum of Rs. 5 lakhs on or before 01/02/2023 which shall abide by the final outcome of the orders passed by the competent Court.
Urmila Ingale 915. aba 1040.22.doc
(e) Such deposit is without prejudice to the right of the complainant to file proceedings for maintenance or any other matrimonial proceedings before the appropriate Court.
4. The anticipatory bail application is disposed of.
The interim application also stands disposed of.

(M. S. KARNIK, J.)
